item.title: Meal - Air Fryer Chicken Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Tortillas - 4
  • Cheese - 1 cup
  • Beans - 1 can
  • Salsa - 1/2 cup
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook and season chicken, then shred
  2. Mix with rice, beans and salsa
  3. Fill tortillas and roll tightly
  4. Air fry at 190°C for 10–12 mins until crispy

Macros

  • Calories - 610
  • Protein - 48g
  • Carbs - 55g
  • Fat - 20g

item.title: Meal - Air Fryer Nachos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Tortilla chips - 150–200g
  • Cheese - 1.5–2 cups (cheddar or blend)
  • Sweet corn - 1/2 cup
  • Bell peppers - 1 cup (chopped)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Jalapeños (optional)

Seasoning

  • Oregano
  • Chilli flakes
  • Salt (optional)

Optional Add-ons

  • Cooked beef or chicken
  • Beans
  • Sour cream
  • Guacamole
  • Salsa

Directions

  1. Line air fryer basket with parchment paper
  2. Add a layer of tortilla chips
  3. Top with vegetables, corn, and cheese
  4. Repeat layers if needed (chips → toppings → cheese)
  5. Sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes
  6. Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes until cheese melts
  7. Remove and add optional toppings (sour cream, salsa, etc.)
  8. Serve immediately

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 30g

Notes

  • Confirmed structure from reel + standard air fryer method :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Best eaten fresh — chips soften quickly after cooking :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Easily adaptable with added protein for a full meal

item.title: Meal - Giant Chicken Poppers
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken mince - 500g
  • Lite Laughing Cow Cheese - 4 wedges
  • Cornflakes - 60g
  • Greek Yogurt - 150g
  • Seasoning
    • Buffalo Chicken
    • Garlic
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Mix chicken mince with seasonings in a large glass bowl
  2. Cover a piece of cheese with mince mix and roll into a ball
  3. Make more balls with cheese in the middle until the mince is gone
  4. Place the balls into the freezer for 30-60 minutes
  5. Blend the cornflakes with additional seasoning
  6. Roll the chicken balls in Greek yogurt
  7. Roll the chicken balls in the cornflake and seasoning mix
  8. Spray the chicken balls with oil
  9. Cook in the air fryer for 15-20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes

Macros

  • Calories - 254 per serving
  • Protein - 36g
  • Carbs - 16g
  • Fat - 4g

Notes

  • Macros are estimated from the ingredients used in the original template

item.title: Meal - Healthy Chicken Nuggets
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
  • Cornflakes or breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Greek yogurt - 150g
  • Egg - 1
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika
    • Garlic powder

Directions

  1. Cut chicken into nugget-sized pieces
  2. Coat in yogurt and egg mixture
  3. Roll in crushed cornflakes or breadcrumbs
  4. Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes until crispy

Macros

item.title: Meal - High Protein Chicken Katsu Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

Chicken Katsu

  • Chicken breast - 600g (sliced or cubed)
  • Egg - 1
  • Cornflakes or panko breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Garlic powder

Fried Rice

  • Cooked rice - 3–4 cups (preferably day-old)
  • Eggs - 2
  • Garlic - 2–3 cloves (minced)
  • Soy sauce - 2–3 tbsp
  • Mixed vegetables - 1–2 cups
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Directions

  1. Coat chicken in egg and seasoning, then cover in crushed cornflakes or panko
  2. Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes until crispy
  3. In a pan, scramble eggs and set aside
  4. Fry garlic in oil until fragrant
  5. Add rice, vegetables, and soy sauce, stirring well
  6. Return eggs and mix through
  7. Slice crispy chicken katsu and place over fried rice
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 560
  • Protein - 50g
  • Carbs - 60g
  • Fat - 12g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption and structure :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Combines Japanese-style chicken katsu with classic fried rice technique
  • Ideal for high-protein meal prep

item.title: Meal - High Protein Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Diced chicken breast - 1.05kg
  • Rice - 700g cooked
  • Garlic - 35ml minced
  • Honey - 60ml
  • Soy sauce - 60ml
  • Eggs - 7
  • Oil - 1 tbsp
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook or air fry the diced chicken until browned and crispy
  2. Scramble the eggs in a large pan and set aside
  3. Fry the garlic in a little oil until fragrant
  4. Add the rice and soy sauce and toss well
  5. Stir through the honey and return the cooked chicken to the pan
  6. Fold through the scrambled egg
  7. Portion and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 546 per serving
  • Protein - 51g
  • Carbs - 67g
  • Fat - 7g

Notes

  • Macros come from the reel caption

item.title: Meal - High Protein Hot Honey Popcorn Chicken
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (cubed)
  • Potatoes - 400–500g (diced or frozen cubes)
  • Greek yogurt - 150g
  • Cornflakes or breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray

Hot Honey Sauce

  • Honey - 2 tbsp
  • Hot sauce - 1 tbsp
  • Chilli flakes (optional)

Directions

  1. Coat diced chicken in Greek yogurt and seasoning
  2. Roll in crushed cornflakes or breadcrumbs
  3. Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes until crispy
  4. Cook potatoes until golden and crispy (air fryer or oven)
  5. Mix honey and hot sauce to create hot honey glaze
  6. Toss cooked chicken in hot honey sauce
  7. Serve with crispy potatoes

Macros

  • Calories - 495
  • Protein - 50g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 12g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption and structure :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
  • High-protein “fakeaway” style meal
  • Very similar structure to KFC popcorn chicken bowls

item.title: Meal - High Protein KFC Chicken Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (cubed)
  • Potatoes - 500g (diced or frozen potato cubes)
  • Corn - 1 cup
  • Gravy - 1/2 cup
  • Greek yogurt - 150g (for coating)
  • Cornflakes or breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika
    • Garlic powder

Directions

  1. Coat diced chicken in Greek yogurt and seasoning
  2. Roll in crushed cornflakes or breadcrumbs
  3. Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes until crispy
  4. Cook potatoes (air fryer or oven) until golden
  5. Heat corn and gravy
  6. Assemble bowl with potatoes, corn, crispy chicken, and gravy on top
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 55g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 12g

Notes

  • Based on KFC “Famous Bowl” style structure
  • Reel explicitly frames this as a high-protein alternative (~60g protein) :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

item.title: Meal - Lasagne Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1 tortilla wrap
  • 4 tbsp bolognese
  • 1 fresh lasagne sheet, or a dried sheet cooked for 5 minutes
  • 2 tbsp béchamel sauce
  • Handful of grated cheese and mozzarella

Directions

  1. Place the wrap flat and layer 2 tbsp bolognese, half the lasagne sheet, 1 tbsp béchamel and cheese.
  2. Repeat the layers once.
  3. Fold into a burrito and wrap it in foil.
  4. Air-fry at 180°C for 10 minutes.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe
